reviewed_by: Claude: Butler home host, focused Butler recovery/home/overview selection
reason: Butler's background checks now reach every Act project. A worker reads only its own project, so a Butler chat stored elsewhere (Butler's home, or another project) was invisible and every recovery case in an Act project without its own Butler chat failed in _butler_session ('(ValueError)'). A shared ButlerFocusRuntime row (no project) now carries a Butler chat's runtime: a home session publishes it for its focus project, and a project's own Butler chat publishes the Nebula-wide default when reserved and again from the anchor on each Nebula-wide check (backfill). _butler_session makes the project's own Butler chat on the focus runtime or else the default, refusing a cloud provider for a local-only project. _global_anchor counts only a project's own chat or focus runtime, so the host does not move. global_status reads 'ready' from a non-host project when the shared clock shows a recent check, else returns host_blocker and host_hint, which Butler Oversight shows. A failed investigation's outcome now keeps the exception type and message and records a diagnostic instead of '(ValueError)'. Selected: the home-host regression file (scoped workers on SQLite and PostgreSQL, including the live shape of one Act host with Butler chats and another Act project without), the product-knowledge regression, the Butler instructions, capacity-retry (investigation failure outcomes), home session, home scope, session reservation and home harness suites, the generic CRUD exposure classification, the runtime bundle compatibility check for the entity-field digest, and the Oversight component and catalog tests.
exclusions: tests/v3/test_butler_recovery.py (test_act_switches_worker_to_provider_and_queues_only_the_parent) and tests/v3/test_tolerant_entity_readers.py (test_a_new_entity_field_needs_a_reviewed_addition_flag) each have one test that fails identically on pristine main 1921d89, so they are left out rather than blocking on unrelated failures; their other tests were run locally and pass. test_execution_locks.py's two-anchor PostgreSQL test passed locally but the file carries a known red PostgreSQL handoff test. No native change. No new operator setting: the settings catalog gains search keywords for the existing BUTLER.md entry. No full-suite approval. Playwright is empty: the only catalogued journey for this path, area butler-global (real-core.spec.ts 'assistant upgrade Nebula-wide Butler checks idle projects'), was run locally on assistant-real-desktop, -chromium-390 and -webkit-390 and passed its Core overview polling, then timed out on every profile clicking a 'Work' button inside a Butler dialog that the current NebulaControlAssistant no longer renders (Butler mode replaced it before this change); that stale step is unrelated to this diff. The operator journey was instead validated on a disposable LAN Core.
